en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard divided into four photographs of a spa resort area. The upper left shows a modernist pavilion with a round glass structure and statue on top, surrounded by trees, labeled "Quellen am Badeplatz". The upper right image shows an elegant Kurhaus‑style building with a classical portico and the word "KURTHEATER" on the pediment, fronted by terraces, paths, and trimmed hedges. The lower left view displays a long colonnaded hall beside a park with lawns, circular fountains, and benches, labeled "Anlagen an der Wandelhalle". The lower right view depicts an open green area or sports/bowling lawn with many people, flanked by low buildings and trees at the edge of a forest, labeled "Badeplatz".
